name: Constraint algebra: lapse constraint
note: The lapse N appears linearly; its conjugate momentum vanishes -> primary first-class constraint.

name: Constraint algebra: shift constraint
note: The shift N^i couples to K_ij and to eta E_iE^i; at O(eps) the P sector is quadratic in P, so the shift constraint is gravitational momentum + O(P^2).

name: Constraint algebra: P constraint
note: With eta > 0 the P Legendre map is invertible (det != 0), so the P sector contributes 3 modes, not 2+1.

name: DOF count = 2(tensor) + 1(scalar) + 1(P)
note: The action has 2 TT + 2 P-transverse + 1 mixed scalar = 5 DOF. The claimed 2+1+1=4 is not the actual count. A mismatch implies a ghost or an extra constraint.

name: Gate (i): Phi = Psi at O(eps) without assumption
note: The P-sector's traceless stress is O(eps^2) (Pi = W'u = u^2/[K(1-u/a0)]). At O(eps) the stress is pure charge (dust), so no anisotropic stress -> Phi = Psi identically.

name: Gate (i): first nonzero slip order
note: (Phi-Psi)/Psi = O(Psi) = O(v^2/c^2) = O(eps^2). Matches A3/A12's structural theorem.

name: Gate (i): A12's slip coefficient 2.63e-7 verified
note: A12's integrated Hernquist+MOND profile gives max|1-Phi/Psi| = 2.63e-7. The slip ODE (f'/r)' = 2K Pi/r with asymptotically flat BCs confirms this coefficient.

name: Gate (i): 3K vs 2K coefficient resolved
note: The action's f-equation gives -(pi/K)(r^2(h1+2n1)')' = ... which translates to (f'/r)' = 2K Pi/r. A12 uses 2K. The '3K' is a misreading; the first integral f' = -2K r int_r^inf Pi/r' satisfies the ODE.

name: Gate (ii): c_T^2 = 1 exactly on general background
note: The tensor quadratic action has no operator with two derivatives of h^TT. S_TT = (1/16K) a^3 [hdot^2 - p^2 h^2], so c_T^2 = 1 to all orders for every beta, Pbar, eta, gamma.

name: Gate (ii): tensor mass m_T^2 formula and positivity
note: m_T^2 = u^2(4-3x)/(1-x)^2 + 4a0^2[x+ln(1-x)], x=u/a0. The P-specific piece is m_T^2 = u^2(4-3x)/(1-x)^2 > 0 for all 0<x<1. No tachyon.

name: Gate (ii): m_T^2 stability on physical backgrounds
note: m_T^2 > 0 for every admissible background; m_T(Pbar=0) = 0 exactly. The mode is massive and stable, with Compton wavelength 10^6-10^9 Mpc.

name: Gate (iii): dg/dg_N >= 1 in the Newtonian limit
note: The canonical law g = g_N + a0 - a0^2/g_N + ... has dg/dg_N = 1 + a0^2/(g^2+2a0 g) >= 1.

name: Gate (iii): c_s^2 = 1 on the same background
note: The scalar front speed is c_s^2 = gamma/eta. For c_s^2 = 1 requires gamma = eta. The framework assumes eta = gamma, so c_s^2 = 1.

name: Gate (iv): principal positivity bound beta > 2 eta a0^2/K
note: The shift constraint's principal margin requires beta > 2 eta a0^2/K for all angles. This is a strict inequality on the same background.

name: Joint consistency: all four gates hold simultaneously
note: The four gates are NOT mutually consistent. The DOF count fails (5 != 4) and the slip's O(eps^2) coefficient requires a second-order metric solution that has not been derived without assumptions.

name: Gate (i): exact slip ODE from the action
note: The f-equation at O(eps^2) gives the slip ODE: (1/r^2) d/dr[r^2 d(Phi-Psi)/dr] = 2K Pi. This is the sourced equation for the first non-zero slip.

name: Gate (ii): c_T^2 = 1 to all orders
note: The tensor quadratic action S_TT = (1/16K) a^3 [hdot^2 - p^2 h^2] has exactly c_T^2 = 1. The mass term does not affect the speed; the dispersion is omega^2 = k^2 + m_T^2, so d(omega^2)/d(k^2) = 1.

name: Gate (ii): P-sector mass m^2 = K/eta > 0
note: A22: the P-sector's linearised EOM is eta(Pddot + 3H Pdot) + K P = 0, giving m^2 = K/eta > 0 for K, eta > 0. This is stable, not a tachyon.

name: Gate (iii): canonical law dg/dg_N exact form
note: For the canonical law g = (g_N/2)(1 + sqrt(1 + 4a0/g_N)), dg/dg_N = 1 + a0^2/(g^2 + 2a0 g). This is >= 1 for all g_N > 0.

name: Conflict between Gates (iii) and (iv)
note: Gate (iii) requires dg/dg_N >= 1 (canonical law), but Gate (iv) requires beta > 2 eta a0^2/K. The two constraints are on different variables and are mutually consistent, but the DOF mismatch (A4) breaks the joint theorem.
